master: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE modular lunar LIVING HABITAT game sprite, inspired by provided lunar-base reference but redesigned for a modular connected moonbase. Soft low-poly toy-like 3D, ivory ceramic/metal walls, charcoal fixtures, small amber trim, dark blue-gray faceted low dome, no branding. Orthographic 2:1 isometric projection (ground axes slope +/-0.5, all verticals vertical), fixed upper-left light. STRICT TILE SPEC: square 1024x1024 transparent canvas; tile is one square isometric cell, ground top diamond corners at (512,512),(960,736),(512,960),(64,736). Thin gray mounting pad with those exact diamond corners, no cast shadow outside pad. Ground center anchor (512,736). All objects horizontally inside x64..960. Low compact habitat center on pad, roof top around y200. Four identical pressure-tunnel collars at MIDPOINTS of the four tile edges, opening centers elevated 100px above pad: NE collar center (736,524), SE (736,748), SW (288,748), NW (288,524). Collars are wide squat ivory ribbed pressure connectors with charcoal sealed openings and subtle amber gasket, not doors with stairs. The two rear collars may be occluded by building but keep geometry logically present. Front two docking collars visibly extend to tile edge so tunnels on adjacent grid cells join without a gap. No stairs or ramps beyond tile. Living module has two small dark observation windows, modest rounded insulated body, low faceted dark blue-gray roof dome. All modules are same cell size, not different physical scales. Transparent background, no terrain, no grid, no text, no labels, no astronaut, no extra props. Exactly one 1x1 object centered on one consistent gray diamond mounting pad.
